event_name: Date 27 October 2018 Time 11:00 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 The driver and a team representative is required to report to the Stewards at 11:30 in relation to the incident below.
reason: Alleged breach of Article 12.1.1 i. of the FIA International Sporting Code. Race Director's Event Notes, document 18, item 16.1, any driver whose car passes completely behind the kerb on the apex of turn 8 must re-join the track by keeping wholly to the right of the fluorescent yellow kerb parallel to the track on the exit of the corner. The Stewards Gerd Ennser Tim Mayer Mika Salo Jorge Rodriguez
title: Doc 20 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Summons Car 18 Failure To Follow Rd Instruction
